m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: All right. Here we go. Don't worry. My research indicates these Pekuliarities are only dangerous under... special circumstances. You'll be fine.
All right, to start, I'll add three flasks of concentrated Pekrons. And... nothing. No reaction whatsoever. Hm. I thought that would do it.
Very well, I'll add just one more flask, and let's see how that reacts... hm. Nothing.
Oh, perhaps I'm being too cautious. Let me just add the rest of this and see what happens...
Great jumping gravity frogs! A Pekuliarity! It worked! I can't-this is... it's actually extremely dangerous! Stand back. Let me neutralize it!
Oh, that was close. Are you all right? Thank the stars... yes, I know I said it was safe, but I didn't actually think it would work. I apologize.
If my research is correct, a Pekuliarity like that, if it weren't under control, could annihilate half of Wizard City!
Ah... but let's keep that quiet for now. Come. Meet me back in Ravenwood and we can discuss what we learned.
That was exciting, wasn't it? A real-life Pekuliarity right in front of us... and they said such a thing couldn't exist. We showed them!
Oh dear, and look at this - your badge is glowing pink... hot pink. That can't be good. I will have to consider the implications of this.
We still need more data to investigate these matters further, so keep checking in for your daily assignments. Until tomorrow, then!
You've been a real asset to the Order, young Wizard. With the Pekron data we've gathered, I believe we're close to some valuable insights!
The first thing we need to ascertain is at what point these Pekrons will produce a Pekuliarity. That'll tell us how imminent the threat really is.
Using the data, I've collected several flasks of air highly concentrated with Pekrons. However, I need your help to test out my theory.
We need somewhere a little more... remote. Just in case, of course. Meet me at Unicorn Park and we'll find out just how volatile these Pekrons can be!
Perfect! You're here just in time. You weren't followed, were you? I think there are some who seek to hinder our research. Very suspicious...
Where was I though? Oh yes! The Pekrons. I am going to add increasing levels of Pekrons to this cauldron, until they produce a Pekuliarity.
You simply need to stand beside the cauldron so your badge can be exposed to it. I'll collect the reading when we're done.
